label: Diagram 22
caption: Diagram 22  Piers and chimneys
description: Diagram 22, titled "Piers and chimneys", with the note "See para 2E2f" at the top left, is a horizontal section of a wall and beam arrangement. Two parallel horizontal lines run across the lower part, representing a beam or plate, with a gap in the lower line under the left-hand stack. The wall profile above shows three raised rectangular sections (stacks): a narrow one on the left, a wide central one, and a narrow one on the right, separated by lower stepped sections. Four dimension lines are marked "X": two vertical lines measure the height of the left and right narrow stacks above the adjacent lower sections, and two horizontal lines measure the width of the tops of these narrow stacks. A single dimension line marked "P", with vertical arrows, measures the vertical distance from the upper horizontal line to the level of the left-hand wall step. Below the section is the caption "Projection X should not be less than P".
first_draft: Diagram 22, titled "Piers and chimneys", with the note "See para 2E2f" at the top left, is a horizontal section (cross-section) of a wall and beam arrangement. Two parallel horizontal lines run across the lower part, representing a beam or plate, with a rectangular opening in the centre through which a chimney stack passes. Above this, a stepped wall profile is shown: a central raised flat-topped section (the stack) flanked on each side by lower stepped piers of differing heights. Four dimension lines are marked "X": at the top left and top right they measure the small outward projection of wall steps with vertical arrows; at the middle they measure, with horizontal arrows, the width of the central flat top; and at the right-middle they measure another step projection with vertical arrows. A single dimension line marked "P", with vertical arrows, measures the height of the central raised stack above the beam line. Below the section is the caption "Projection X should not be less than P".
